items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: Now, in the case of Jo Jones being another type of person, Jo Jones always was considered -- I think he considers himself and he acts in the form of a teacher.

ctx.x: Right. And so in other words as I said,

where these people would be hard to understand by others, who didn't fit in the environment or in this circle of musicians, well, I had no problems because they loved me. Well, now in the sense of the word. For instance I would have to say that Lester Young loved me because I later on played with them and he expressed his love for me warmly.
